title: Fix barcode scanner in admin billing with high-speed library and professional features

requirements.text: Integrate a high-speed barcode scanning library (QuaggaJS, ZXing, or Html5-QRCode) into the admin billing page to reliably recognize standard retail barcodes including EAN-13 and UPC formats

quotes: Integrate High-Speed Barcode Library: Use a powerful scanning library (like QuaggaJS, ZXing, or Html5-QRCode) to ensure the camera can instantly recognize standard retail barcodes (EAN-13, UPC, etc.)

acceptanceCriteria: Barcode scanner successfully detects and decodes EAN-13 and UPC barcodes
Scanner uses one of the specified libraries (QuaggaJS, ZXing, or Html5-QRCode)
Scanning works reliably with standard retail product barcodes

requirements.text: Enable auto-focus for the camera and add a Flash/Torch toggle button within the scanner UI to support scanning in low-light conditions

quotes: Auto-Focus & Flash Support: Enable auto-focus and provide a 'Flash/Torch' toggle button within the scanner UI to help scanning in low-light conditions

acceptanceCriteria: Camera uses auto-focus mode when available
UI includes a visible Flash/Torch toggle button
Flash/Torch can be turned on and off during scanning
Scanner works effectively in low-light environments when flash is enabled

requirements.text: Implement instant product fetch: when a barcode is successfully scanned, automatically fetch the product name, price, and GST details from the database and add it to the billing list without requiring any manual clicks

quotes: Instant Product Fetch: As soon as a barcode is scanned, the app should automatically fetch the product name, price, and GST details from the database and add it to the billing list without any manual clicks

acceptanceCriteria: Scanned barcode triggers immediate product lookup in the backend
Product with matching barcode is retrieved with name, price, and GST details
Product is automatically added to the billing list without user interaction
Entire flow happens seamlessly after scan recognition

requirements.text: Enable continuous scanning mode that allows the admin to scan multiple items one after another without closing the camera after each scan

quotes: Continuous Scanning Mode: Allow the admin to scan multiple items one after another without closing the camera after every single scan

acceptanceCriteria: Camera remains open after a successful scan
Admin can immediately scan another barcode without reopening the scanner
Scanner only closes when explicitly dismissed by the admin
Multiple products can be added in rapid succession

requirements.text: Add a beep sound notification that plays when a barcode is successfully scanned to provide audio feedback to the admin

quotes: Beep Sound on Success: Add a 'Beep' sound notification once a barcode is successfully scanned to give feedback to the admin

acceptanceCriteria: Distinct beep sound plays immediately after successful scan
Sound provides clear confirmation without being disruptive
Audio feedback works consistently across scan sessions

requirements.text: Implement error handling that shows a quick popup with the message 'Product Not Found - Add Manually?' when a scanned barcode is not found in the database

quotes: Error Handling: If a barcode is not found in the database, show a quick popup 'Product Not Found - Add Manually?'

acceptanceCriteria: Popup appears when barcode lookup returns no matching product
Popup displays the exact text 'Product Not Found - Add Manually?'
Popup provides clear visual feedback and is easy to dismiss
Scanner remains ready to scan next item after error handling

requirements.text: Update camera permission request description to: 'This app requires camera access for the Admin Billing Panel to scan product barcodes, ensuring fast and error-free billing for customers'

quotes: Camera Access Description: "This app requires camera access for the Admin Billing Panel to scan product barcodes, ensuring fast and error-free billing for customers."

acceptanceCriteria: Camera permission prompt shows the specified description
Description complies with app store requirements for permission justification

constraints: Use one of the specified barcode libraries: QuaggaJS, ZXing, or Html5-QRCode
Scanner must support EAN-13 and UPC barcode formats
Product lookup must use existing backend product data with barcode field
Maintain compatibility with existing billing flow in BillingPage.tsx
nonGoals: Adding new product fields or modifying product schema
Implementing manual barcode entry enhancements beyond existing functionality
Supporting QR codes or non-retail barcode formats
Creating a separate handheld scanner device integration
